The refinement is in. Quick confirmation on **http://maker:4001** (refresh):

**Change an address.** Click **"✎ Edit"** on a card, change the **Address** to a different site (e.g. `https://github.com`), and Save. You'll see it briefly re-fetch, then show the *new* page's title and description with a **freshly dated saved copy** — while your **tags and note stay attached**. If instead you only edit the title or description (leaving the address unchanged), those edits are kept exactly as you typed them.

Does that match what you wanted for address changes?

If yes, that rounds out the management flows. Here's where we stand — all your goal's capabilities are now settled as working flows:

- Save a link (auto title/description) · open original · full edit
- Tags (reuse existing, create new, shown on cards)
- Notes (Markdown, preview + expand)
- Search (live, all-fields, with `#tag` / phrases / AND-OR-NOT / parentheses)
- Reading list (opt-in) · Archive (recoverable) 
- Preserved copy of every link (PDF kept as original)
- Delete (confirmed, permanent) · duplicate-prevention on save

Once you confirm the address-change behavior, I'll record it and then move us into exploring **boundary situations** — things like a brand-new empty library, a very large collection, and unusual inputs — to make sure the app stays dependable in the corners before we build it for real.
